question: Can seed 116 be inverted with a truth-free |ω| bracket (s019 Lomb-Scargle) in under 15 minutes?
hypothesis: Replacing the truth-centered |ω| band with the blind s019 LS bracket plus two-stage coarse-K→full-500 scoring inverts seed 116 blind in <15 min.
narrative_md: Fixed s098's two holes: replaced the truth-centered |ω| band with the blind s019 LS bracket (validated held-out 20/20 on seeds 100-119) and cut the wall 9.6× to 705 s (11.7 min) via coarse-K-decimated RMSE (Spearman 0.997) + two-stage scoring. Top blind candidate renders hi-fi ρ 0.52 (Band A); all 15 saved blind candidates Band A (ρ 0.52-0.75), a mix of near-truth-ω basins and body-twins.
